draft.subject: Hardware and Electronics Intern role at NDimensions Labs
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I saw the Hardware and Electronics Intern, Robotics opening at NDimensions Labs, and since you work on the robotics hardware and electronics side, I wanted to write to you directly.

The posting asks for sensor and actuator integration, microcontrollers, PCB and CAD tools, and careful testing, and that is the work I have done. For my capstone I built a vision guided robot arm, wiring a Jetson and an Arduino to servos and distance sensors over an I2C mux, and I tracked down a long list of integration failures, servo brown outs included. Before that I designed and fabricated custom PCBs in EAGLE for competition robots and wrote motor control and encoder code on Arduino and bare metal firmware on STM32.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
